# WebsiteBench

WebsiteBench asks whether AI agents can reconstruct a website through browser exploration. The active website cohort has 70 tasks and nine models, with a 16-hour run budget. Untappd, RoomSketcher, Workable and edX are excluded; historical materials are preserved.

## Results

Table, Pareto and Waffle use the same versioned HF catalog and context policy. Overall and T1/T2/T3 are arithmetic means of available per-task fractions. Missing scores are excluded, never counted as zero. Coverage is shown for each metric. Resource values are reported estimates or partial records where qualified; Pareto uses the same task subset on both axes.

- Canonical data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/TIGER-Lab/WebsiteBenchArtifacts
- Active tasks: data/cohort.json
- Contexts and aggregates: data/leaderboard-views.json
- Exact per-task scores: data/waffle.json
- Remaining gaps: https://huggingface.co/datasets/TIGER-Lab/WebsiteBenchArtifacts/blob/main/missing/score-gaps.md
- Run instructions: run.html
- Task explorer and ATIF browser: tasks.html
- Analysis: analysis.html
- Citation: CITATION.bib
